#### .ctor

```text
public System.Void .ctor(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable`1<PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.IConnectionSource> sources, PPDS.Dataverse.Resilience.IThrottleTracker throttleTracker, PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.ConnectionPoolOptions poolOptions, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger`1<PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.DataverseConnectionPool> logger)
```

Initializes a new connection pool from connection sources.

- Parameter `sources`: One or more connection sources providing seed clients. Each source&#x27;s seed will be cloned to create pool members.
- Parameter `throttleTracker`: Throttle tracking service.
- Parameter `poolOptions`: Pool configuration options.
- Parameter `logger`: Logger instance.
